paper_metadata.title: Pt-Al-Cr-Ni Superalloys: Heat Treatment and Microstructure

evidence.quote: Pt-Al-Cr-Ni Superalloys: Heat Treatment and Microstructure
In order to examine the influence of chromium on the precipitate morphology and volume fraction, the alloys Pt82Al12Ni6 and Pt76Al12Cr6Ni6 were investigated.
Small cuboidal-shaped precipitates in an fcc matrix were observed in the ternary Pt-Al-Cr system by transmission electron microscopy.
